title: 皐月賞の後に・まだ追いつけない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the Satsuki Sho being Nice Nature's preferred distance, she fails to catch up to Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In contrast to Nice Nature's frustration, Tokai Teio is clearly motivated to train for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing this, Nice Nature bemoans the fact that Teio is far beyond her reach.
